close.busyTitle: A package is still being sent to the PS4
close.busyDetail: Closing now would interrupt the download on the console. PKG Sender can keep running in the system tray and close by itself when it finishes.
tray.tooltip: PKG Sender: sending a package to the PS4
status.title: Console connection
nav.gamepadConnected: Controller connected: use the D-pad to move, ✕ to choose, ○ to go back and L1/R1 to switch tabs.
library.emptyText: Add the folders where you keep your PKGs. Subfolders are searched too, and PKG Sender shows the cover, title and version of each one.
library.newerThanPs4: Newer than the one on the PS4
library.alreadyAdded: These were already in the library.
console.notConfiguredHint: Find the console on the network or type its IP in Settings.
console.connecting: Connecting to the GoldHEN FTP server
jobs.waitingPs4: Waiting for the PS4 to start the download
jobs.doneToast: {title} was sent to the PS4, which finishes installing it in a moment.
jobs.ps4NotReady: The PS4 is not answering right now. The package was queued anyway.
jobs.leftOnPs4: could not take the download off the PS4 list: delete it from its notifications
uninstall.title: Delete from PS4
uninstall.note: Your saved data stays on the PS4. Deleting uses the system uninstaller through GoldHEN and cannot be undone: to play again, install the PKG again.
uninstall.offline: The PS4 is not answering. Check that it is on with GoldHEN loaded.
uninstall.gameHint: Removes the game and its installed update, freeing about {size}.
uninstall.patchHint: The game stays installed, at version v{version}.
settings.title: Settings
settings.goldhenNote: PKG Sender installs and deletes through GoldHEN: keep the FTP server and the BinLoader server enabled in Settings > GoldHEN > Server Settings.
settings.lanInfo: The PS4 downloads packages from this PC at {ip}. If your firewall asks, allow PKG Sender on private networks.
settings.aboutText: PKG Sender {version} · free software under the GPL-3.0 license · source code on GitHub
settings.noneFound: No PS4 found. Check that it is on and on the same network, or type its IP above.
settings.klog.live: Following the PS4 in real time (failures, cancels and deletions show up right away).
settings.klog.busy: Another program is reading the PS4 log, which serves one reader at a time. PKG Sender takes it back when a download starts; until then, changes made on the PS4 show up late.
settings.klog.unavailable: The PS4 log (port 3232) does not answer: check that GoldHEN's Klog server is on. Without it, failures and deletions show up late.
settings.diagnosticsHint: Versions, connections and recent events, to attach when reporting a problem.
errors.notPkg: This is not a PS4 PKG.
errors.pkgTableInvalid: The PKG file table is invalid.
errors.consoleFtp: Could not read the PS4 over FTP ({detail}). Check that GoldHEN is loaded with its FTP server enabled.
errors.payloadTextTooLong: The package information is too long to send to the PS4.
errors.payloadInvalid: The payload file is invalid. Reinstall PKG Sender.
errors.payloadMissing: The GoldHEN payloads are missing. Reinstall PKG Sender.
errors.binloaderUnavailable: GoldHEN's BinLoader is not accepting payloads. On the PS4, open Settings > GoldHEN > Server Settings and turn the BinLoader server off and on again (or restart the PS4 and load GoldHEN).
errors.payloadNoAnswer: The payload did not answer. Check that the BinLoader server is enabled in GoldHEN.
errors.payloadTimeout: The PS4 did not answer in time.
errors.pkgNotFound: This PKG is no longer in the library.
errors.pkgUnreadable: This file cannot be installed because it could not be read.
errors.alreadyQueued: This PKG is already in the queue.
errors.pkgRemoved: The PKG was removed from the library.
errors.noLan: Could not find this PC's local network.
errors.downloadStalled: The PS4 stopped downloading the package.
errors.downloadNotStarted: The PS4 did not start downloading the package. Check the notification on the PS4 screen.
errors.notOnConsole: This item is no longer on the PS4. Refresh the list.
errors.noPatchInstalled: This game has no update installed.
errors.uninstallRefused: The PS4 refused to delete it (code {code}).
errors.uninstallRefusedInit: The PS4 refused to delete it (code {code}; init {init}).
errors.uninstallNotApplied: The PS4 accepted the request, but the item is still installed. Try deleting it from the PS4 menu.
errors.ps4DownloadFailed: The PS4 could not download the package (code {code}). Check the notification on the PS4.
errors.ps4Cancelled: The download was cancelled on the PS4.
errors.installFailed: The PS4 downloaded the package but could not install it (code {code}).
errors.nothingToAdd: Nothing to add: drop folders or .pkg files.
drop.title: Drop to add to the library
drop.hint: Folders join the folder list; .pkg files are added one by one.
